features: Complete pointed recovery nose, slender constant-diameter body and aft fin/propulsion body, with the two visible opposed swept fin projections.
Overall height 10.82 m and diameter 635 mm; section proportions use printed lengths 1.68/1.40/0.38/1.65/2.25/2.26/1.20 m. BLK3 is distinct from SARGE (508 mm).
coverage.limitations: Source-dated side projection, not an engineering model or flight livery. Fin outline is approximate from the visible projection; total hidden fin count, hidden nozzle geometry, internal hardware and current flight appearance are unspecified. Neutral SpaceFox colours and minimal section bands are informational. No logo or source lettering.

geometryReference.basis: EXOS Payload User Guide July 2026, PDF page 4, heading 2. BLK3 SRLV; current EXOS pricing page links this guide. Printed module lengths sum to 10.82 m; guide prose states BLK3 diameter 635 mm versus precursor SARGE 508 mm.
